_comment: THROWAWAY probe courier config (harness V1). inboxes_dir:'auto' exercises the WS1 runtime-discovery sentinel. ssh_target is a dummy -- the throwaway has no hub; V1 validates PATH RESOLUTION (does 'auto' resolve to the live session-<id> dir?), NOT a full hub round-trip (no SSH egress to a hub in the throwaway). state_dir is local + on the same volume as ~/.claude so the same-volume startup check passes.
